citation: Guzmán, J. C., Schuenke-Lucien, K., D'Agostino, A. J., Berends, M., & Elliot, A. J. (2021). Improving reading instruction and students' reading skills in the early grades: Evidence from a randomized evaluation in Haiti. Reading Research Quarterly, 56(4), 657-677. https://doi.org/10.1002/rrq.297
design: Cluster RCT; assignment at school level; 94 schools randomized (45 treatment, 49 control); end-of-grade-2 analytic sample 92 schools (43 treatment, 49 control); subject = reading/literacy (Creole + French early-grade literacy, Read to Learn / ToTAL curriculum + teacher training + coaching); grades 1-2 (K-2).
problems: Effect sizes taken from the END-OF-GRADE-2 wave (spring 2016), the end-of-treatment measurement; end-of-grade-1 (spring 2015) is an earlier intermediate wave (gs 0.19-0.77) and is recorded in per-effect notes only, not as separate rows. g values are reported directly by the authors in Table 6 (Hedges's g per WWC 2017b = covariate-adjusted mean difference / unadjusted pooled within-group SD); g_se computed centrally as the Table-5 HLM Treatment-coefficient SE divided by the same unadjusted pooled SD (reproduces the reported g to <0.02). The HLM/ANCOVA impact already adjusts for clustering and baseline covariates, so g is treated as cluster_adjusted; design ICC was not reported (null). Reading comprehension was administered only to a non-full subsample (not all tested students); my recomputed g for it is ~0.21 vs reported 0.19 (kept reported value), and is_full_sample=false. Listening-comprehension subtasks (Oral Creole/French) are listening, not reading-decoding, outcomes but are reported within the EGRA battery and labeled secondary. EGRA here was administered by study enumerators for this study and is not a norm-referenced/standardized state test, so test_type=researcher_made.

effect_sizes.timepoint: end of grade 2 (spring 2016, end of treatment)
effect_sizes.g_method: Reported Hedges's g (Table 6) = covariate-adjusted mean difference / unadjusted pooled within-group SD (WWC 2017b). g_se = Table-5 HLM Treatment coef SE (2.77) / pooled SD (22.85). mean_t/mean_c are covariate-adjusted means; sd_t/sd_c are unadjusted SDs.
effect_sizes.notes: Emergent reading skill (letter recognition). End-of-grade-1 g was 0.32.
